name: throttle-near-monorepo
description: Adaptive spending-control vault for autonomous AI agents on NEAR Protocol

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build:contract: cd contracts/throttle-vault && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --no-abi
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit -p .
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run typecheck && npm run build:frontend && npm run test:contract
